original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract, not another mixture already covered by the frozen catalogue.

first_step.inspect: Read the frozen catalogue bound exclusions and select one genuinely different helper endpoint inventory.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write the complete optimistic child histogram and reject it immediately if even the relaxation has insufficient headroom.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Helper inventory changes can improve the moment; repacking a covered cost interface cannot evade its scoped bound.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: Prove the complete recursive moment optimum for arbitrary finite rational factorizations in the twelve fixed eight-array late block interfaces, on the selected word and both PR1319 providers. Retain the single-word provider whose backward program is the same-order inverse-transpose dual.
scope_change_reason: The donor assigned within-call non-centre rank shape. The joint factorization route uses the existing eight physical arrays and changes all internal gate orders and lengths; it is distinct from the default new-inventory card. The fixed late output interface was declared before the proof work. The controller statement uses the actual coupled provider orientation rule; it does not cover independent backward-interface synthesis.
bottleneck_link: Pointwise optimality of every complete helper moment prevents any decrease in the complex supplier moment or expansion of the retained complete outer-recipe feasible region.
stop_rule: Stop only after a proof covers arbitrary finite programs in the declared class and the emitted native word attains its lower bound; otherwise report no publishable result.
evidence: PROOF.md and CERTIFICATE.json: 36 exact source/block interfaces, 9180 nonempty input subsets, 36 nonsingular boundary minors checked in both directions, and 12 rejected mutations.

ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematical reasoning, source extraction, exact verification, and prose.
